alias_and_scope_checks.decision: The new UNMASK defense differs from the existing masked-diffusion-language-model attack paper; similarity of titles does not establish a duplicate.
The new OPD propagation work has different authors and study details from the existing OPD-for-safety study.

Related-author studies with distinct victim modalities: visual backdoors in VLM OPD versus conditional backdoors in LLM OPD. Retained distinct records; no source metadata identifies a renamed submission.

Same authors and related spectral defense ideas, but distinct source identifiers and method descriptions: SVD projection using offline triggered samples versus hash-assisted combinatorial signatures and anomaly-gated scrubbing. No explicit replacement/version statement found in supplied metadata; not merged solely for author overlap.
Different-author weight-space programming studies with different victim evaluations; LLM attackers were not mistaken for compromised agent victims.
